name: glenski-quality-suite
description: Evidence-led developer skills for release, security, content, and frontend quality

interface.shortDescription: Open-source developer skills built through real work.
interface.longDescription: Glenski Assurance Suite is a growing collection of validated, portable developer skills. This release covers cross-platform frontend checks, evidence-based software audits, defensive Python web-app security checks, and natural-voice editing. Each skill is shaped by real project work, then published with clear limits and repeatable evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Choose the right Glenski Assurance skill for this project.
